DISCUSSION BOARD
Discussion board questions will be posted each week and answers are due every
Thursday, prior to 6:00 p.m. EST. Discussion board questions are worth ten points each. One sentence answers
are not acceptable. If your answers are late, a three-point deduction will be deducted from the ten points.

Grading

Grades are calculated by Brightspace on a weekly basis.

Attendance Policy

0-2 Absences 5%

3 Absences 2.5%

4 Absences 0%

If you miss more than 4 absences you will not only lose 5% in attendance, but your grade will also

be reduced further by one full letter grade (10% decrease). Please keep track of your absences and

grades as the semester progresses.

COURSE SCHEDULE
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Threats and vulnerabilities
Thursday, prior to 6:00 p.m. EST. Discussion board questions are worth ten points each. One sentence answers
must include supporting examples.
